english: Consider then a person who has a scratch on the surface of their eye, and who thus thinks they see a hair lying on the surface of their kitchen sink. How could you say then that a hair was appearing to their eyes? A person can perceive that things are deceptive-that they are like an illusion-because they have understood what deceptive reality is; but that doesn't mean they have to take it as real.
